description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order to amend the Ex. Gaz. No. 1482/26 of 02.02.2007 substituting entry as Department of Manufacturing & Industrial Engineering, University of Peradeniya
reasoning: This gazette notification is an order made by the Minister of Higher Education and Highways under the Universities Act, specifically amending the academic department structure (changing "Department of Production Engineering" to "Department of Manufacturing and Industrial Engineering") within the University of Peradeniya. While it involves a government minister, it does not contain government structural changes (Type 1), personnel appointments (Type 2), or detailed portfolio responsibilities (Type 3). Instead, it deals specifically with higher education administration and academic matters, which falls under the Miscellaneous category (Type 10) for educational matters not covered by other specialized types.
